questions.question: What question does David repeat in Psalm 13?
options: Where can I flee from your presence?
What is man that you are mindful of him?
How long, O LORD? Will you forget me forever?
Why do all the nations rage against your people?
questions.answer: How long, O LORD? Will you forget me forever?

questions.question: How does the psalm end despite its lament?
options: Trusting in God's steadfast love and rejoicing in salvation
Marveling in wonder at the glories of all creation
Calling down fierce judgment upon all of his enemies
Confessing his own deep sin and seeking God's full forgiveness
questions.answer: Trusting in God's steadfast love and rejoicing in salvation
